summary: Narrow steep street with a house within 9-11 m along the whole kerb.
reasons: Narrow lane, little room off the lane

best_section.where: Graham Street east kerb, near the bottom by the cross street

drivers.seclusion: Large homes front the kerb; dwellings at 10-11 m even at the flattest end.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with a tree-lined verge; no pull-off seen.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street beside a school.
drivers.convention: Signs are 4P on school days only; no evidence of overnight stays.

flags: School drop-off street, busy on weekdays
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over the kerb, mainly from the west.
